snippet.title: Relic Hunters Legend | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Relic Hunters Legend – Official Launch Date Trailer
🗓️ Launching August 14, 2025 on PC (Steam) and Xbox!

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/633080/Relic_Hunters_Legend/

Fast. Fluid. Fun. Relic Hunters Legend is a premium looter shooter RPG packed with explosive action, deep build customization, and an emotional story about friendship, rebellion, and time travel.

Go solo or team up in 4-player online co-op to take on powerful enemies, collect legendary loot, and customize your Hunters with layered RPG systems. Whether you’re grinding for gear, crafting the perfect build, or uncovering the mysteries of the past—Relic Hunters Legend delivers a unique top-down shooter experience like no other.

🎮 Key Features:

30+ hours of fully voiced story content across 3 Acts

9 game modes and 30+ handcrafted maps

100+ legendary weapons, relics, and gear to collect

Deep endgame for theorycrafters and build-optimizers

Offline solo or online 4-player co-op

Full original soundtrack and The Compendium system to track your progress

200+ hours of content for completionists

🔥 From the creators of Hell Clock and Relic Hunters Zero, this is Rogue Snail’s most ambitious RPG yet.

🧠 Perfect for fans of:

Looter Shooters (like Borderlands, Destiny, Warframe)

Action RPGs (like Diablo, Hades, Path of Exile)

Games with deep customization and rewarding grind loops

📌 Don’t forget to wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/633080/Relic_Hunters_Legend/
